var ALPHABET="#$%&'()*+,-./0123456789:;=?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[]^_`abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{|}~",LOOKUP={};
for(var ai=0;ai<ALPHABET.length;ai++)LOOKUP[ALPHABET.charAt(ai)]=ai;
function readInt(code,state){var n=0,mul=1,v;do{v=LOOKUP[code.charAt(state.i++)];if(v===undefined)throw Error('Invalid drawing coordinates');n+=(v%44)*mul;mul*=44}while(v>=44);return n}
function drawPart(ctx,part,x,y,width,height){
if(!part)throw Error('Drawing format not found');
x=x||0;y=y||0;width=width===undefined?part.w:width;height=height===undefined?part.h:height;
ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(width/part.w,height/part.h);
for(var i=0;i<part.layers.length;i++){var layer=part.layers[i],code=layer[1],state={i:0},position=0;ctx.fillStyle=layer[0];
while(state.i<code.length){position+=readInt(code,state);var rw=readInt(code,state)+1,rh=readInt(code,state)+1;ctx.fillRect(position%part.w,Math.floor(position/part.w),rw,rh)}}ctx.restore();}

var TCCITY={ok:function(){return true},camFor:function(){return{}},view:function(c,key,cam,v,w,h){var p=BACKDROPS[key];if(!p)throw Error('World scene not captured: '+key);drawPart(c,p,0,0,w,h);return true}};
var TCK=(function(){
 const TAU=Math.PI*2,cl=(v,a,b)=>v<a?a:v>b?b:v,lerp=(a,b,u)=>a+(b-a)*u,sm=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u*u*(3-2*u)},seg=(t,a,b)=>cl((t-a)/(b-a),0,1),eio=u=>{u=cl(u,0,1);return u<.5?4*u*u*u:1-Math.pow(-2*u+2,3)/2};
 const HX={};function hx(h){if(HX[h])return HX[h];let s=String(h).replace('#','');if(s.length===3)s=s.split('').map(q=>q+q).join('');const n=parseInt(s.slice(0,6),16)||0;return HX[h]=[n>>16&255,n>>8&255,n&255]}
 function mix(a,b,u){const A=hx(a),B=hx(b);u=cl(u,0,1);return'#'+A.map((v,i)=>Math.round(v+(B[i]-v)*u).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')}
 function rgba(h,a){const A=hx(h);return'rgba('+A[0]+','+A[1]+','+A[2]+','+cl(a,0,1).toFixed(3)+')'}
 function rng(seed){let s=(seed>>>0)||1;return()=>{s=(Math.imul(s,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;return s/4294967296}}
  
 function kf(keys,t,ease){ease=ease||sm;if(t<=keys[0][0])return keys[0].slice(1);for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1];if(t<b[0]){const u=ease((t-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]));return a.slice(1).map((v,j)=>typeof v==='string'?mix(v,b[j+1],u):lerp(v,b[j+1],u))}}return keys[keys.length-1].slice(1)}
  
 function walker(keys,stride){stride=stride||46;const segs=[];let acc=0;for(let i=0;i<keys.length-1;i++){const a=keys[i],b=keys[i+1],d=Math.hypot(b[1]-a[1],(b[2]||0)-(a[2]||0));segs.push({a,b,d,acc});acc+=d}
  return t=>{if(t<=keys[0][0])return{x:keys[0][1],y:keys[0][2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:0};for(const q of segs){if(t<q.b[0]){const u0=(t-q.a[0])/(q.b[0]-q.a[0]),u=lerp(u0,sm(u0),.55),x=lerp(q.a[1],q.b[1],u),y=lerp(q.a[2]||0,q.b[2]||0,u);return{x,y,moving:q.d>1?1:0,dir:Math.sign(q.b[1]-q.a[1]),ph:(q.acc+q.d*u)/stride}}}const L=keys[keys.length-1];return{x:L[1],y:L[2]||0,moving:0,dir:0,ph:acc/stride}}}

 function armTargets(P,B,T){const pr=P.arms||'down',d=P.turn>=0?1:-1,sy=B.sy,ph=P.walk!=null?P.walk*TAU:0,sw=P.walk!=null?Math.sin(ph)*(P.run?9:5):0,o={};
  const down=[[-B.sw-2.2-sw*.2,sy+30],[B.sw+2.2+sw*.2,sy+30]];
  const set=(a,b)=>{o.a=a;o.b=b};
  switch(typeof pr==='string'?pr:'custom'){
   case'down':set([down[0][0]+sw*(P.turn||0),down[0][1]],[down[1][0]-sw*(P.turn||0),down[1][1]]);break;
   case'hips':set([-B.sw-6,sy+24],[B.sw+6,sy+24]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'wave':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set(down[0],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'wave2':{const w=Math.sin(T*9)*5;set([-B.sw-12-w,sy-26],[B.sw+12+w,sy-26]);break}
   case'up':set([-B.sw-6,sy-34],[B.sw+6,sy-34]);break;
   case'cheer':{const w=Math.sin(T*7)*4;set([-B.sw-9+w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)],[B.sw+9-w,sy-30-Math.abs(w)]);break}
   case'point':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-28,sy+2],d>0?[B.sw+28,sy+2]:down[1]);break;
   case'pointUp':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-12,sy-30],d>0?[B.sw+12,sy-30]:down[1]);break;
   case'chin':set(d>0?down[0]:[-2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9],d>0?[2,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.9]:down[1]);break;
   case'head':set([-B.sw+1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7],[B.sw-1,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.7]);break;
   case'clap':{const op=Math.abs(Math.sin(T*11))*5;set([-1.5-op,sy+15],[1.5+op,sy+15]);break}
   case'front':set([-5,sy+19],[5,sy+19]);break;
   case'hold':set([d*6-5,sy+16],[d*6+5,sy+16]);break;
   case'lantern':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-10,sy+14],d>0?[B.sw+10,sy+14]:down[1]);break;
   case'pull':{const k=Math.sin(T*3)*3;set([d*(16+k)-3,sy+20],[d*(26+k)+3,sy+17]);break}
   case'shrug':set([-B.sw-9,sy+9],[B.sw+9,sy+9]);o.bend=1;break;
   case'think':set(down[0],[3,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.95]);break;
   case'shade':set(down[0],[d*3+2,B.hy-B.hr[1]*.35]);break;
   case'crank':{const a=T*4.2;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*5-2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5],[d*14+Math.cos(a)*5+2,sy+20+Math.sin(a)*5]);break}
   case'wheel':{const a=Math.sin(T*1.6)*.5;set([d*16+Math.cos(Math.PI+a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(Math.PI+a)*8],[d*16+Math.cos(a)*8,sy+16+Math.sin(a)*8]);break}
   case'radio':set(d>0?down[0]:[-4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8],d>0?[4,B.hy+B.hr[1]*.8]:down[1]);break;
   case'bow':set([-4,sy+34],[4,sy+34]);break;
   case'shake':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-16,sy+20],d>0?[B.sw+16,sy+20+Math.sin(T*10)*2]:down[1]);break;
   case'give':set(d>0?down[0]:[-B.sw-18,sy+10],d>0?[B.sw+18,sy+10]:down[1]);break;
   case'row':{const a=T*3;set([d*14+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3],[d*20+Math.cos(a)*6,sy+22+Math.sin(a)*3]);break}
   default:set(pr.a||down[0],pr.b||down[1]);o.bend=pr.bend}
  return o}
  
 function fig(c,x,y,s,L,P){P=P||{};const boy=!!L.boy,B=boy?BOY:MAN,T=P.t||0,turn=cl(P.turn||0,-1,1),at=Math.abs(turn),d=turn>=0?1:-1;

  if(P.shadow!==false){c.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.28)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,15,3.2,0,0,TAU);c.fill()}
   
  const hipY=B.hip+yb,legW=B.limb[2],shW=B.limb[3],long=L.pants!=='shorts';const legs=[];
  for(const i of [0,1]){const hx0=(i?1:-1)*B.hw*.48*(1-at*.3),side=i?1:-1;let fx,fy,kn=d;
   if(P.legs==='sit'){const kx=hx0+d*B.th*Math.max(.3,at)*.95;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+2,kx+d*1.5,0]);continue}
   if(P.legs==='kneel'){if(i===(d>0?0:1)){legs.push([hx0,hipY,hx0+d*2,hipY+B.th*.95,hx0-d*B.sh*.7,-1])}else{const kx=hx0+d*B.th*.75;legs.push([hx0,hipY,kx,hipY+B.th*.35,kx,0])}continue}

 function crane(c,x,y,h,jib,ang,hookY,o){o=o||{};const nt=o.night||0,col=K.mix('#f2c230','#5a4a1a',nt);c.strokeStyle=col;c.lineWidth=3;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-6,y);c.lineTo(x-6,y-h);c.moveTo(x+6,y);c.lineTo(x+6,y-h);for(let yy=y;yy>y-h;yy-=14){c.moveTo(x-6,yy);c.lineTo(x+6,yy-14)}c.stroke();
